$comment: Combat (ruleset v0; spec S2 sections 5 and 6, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). melee.engagedSpeedPermille: a soldier with an enemy in reach moves at this share of its speed. volley: hits land on target soldiers within impactRadiusMm of the aim point; up to closeRangePermille of range a volley hits at its near chance. regimentTargeting is S2's working default until the regiment AI (M7): attackers turn on an enemy regiment within attackerEngageMm, defenders leave their ground for one within defenderEngageMm, ranged regiments shoot when a target is in range and fall back rangedFallbackMm when enemy melee comes within rangedFallbackTriggerMm. order (S2 2.2, D1; the doubling is the brief's, 2026-11-07): open order multiplies file and rank spacing by openSpacingPermille, and a volley at an open-order regiment lands openArrowHitsPermille of its hits; nothing sets open order yet: the plan's per-regiment order flag arrives with the base types (item 6). smallRegimentsBlockCasts false (D15, settled 2026-11-07): regiments that deploy with fewer than smallRegimentSoldiers soldiers (Crossing Marshals, Drovers) do not block casts under the range rule; they still count for wiping and holding.

charge.$comment: Charges and trampling (spec S2 section 10, settled 2026-11-07 with D7 and D8; numbers are proposals). A cavalry regiment (unit type charges) engaging a target charges when the target's outline is startMinMm to startMaxMm away and the straight line to its centroid is open for horse with no cell of mud at least blockedByMudAtLeast, water at least blockedByWaterMm, or ice (D8). Riders accelerate at accelMmPerS2 to speedMmPerS; a rider counts as charging while at least chargingMinMmPerS. The charge ends after maxRunMm, when half the riders have made contact, or when a rider hits deep ground (deepMudStop, D7: stopped dead, stunned, no damage, cause thrown in the mud); then cooldownTicks, and a regiment that has charged must be rechargeSeparationMm from the enemy to charge again. Contact: each charging rider takes at most targetsPerRider enemy soldiers on their feet in body contact within frontArcCd of his heading, once per charge; each is launched (launches.json charge) with launchPermille, otherwise trampled (trampleDamage, armour ignored, stunned trampleStunTicks); then the rider slows to afterContactMmPerS and fights. Braced targets (a braces unit type in close order, slower than maxSpeedMmPerS, its regiment facing within facingArcCd of the charge's reverse) are launched with braced.launchPermille and the rider takes riderDamagePerTarget each. Landings only knock down (S2 9.3): never a chain. braceHolds (brief 2026-11-15): a close-order regiment of a braces type that an enemy regiment is charging holds its ground until that charge ends, without turning to face it, so a flank or rear charge meets it unbraced; open order keeps its orders.
